book.name: Ibeliu
book.title: IBELIU MeIbeliu ꞌidi leta Yesu weyahina

content: Cina gwae hemisaina ꞌabwa ꞌimiyamiya ꞌabehega ꞌina ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasi tauna ꞌoinega taloba, eeta ꞌilobwainegita ma tamatauta ꞌamuge ta tupwami wabeꞌu ma sahena walobaloba.
Moisa, wasaina ꞌiꞌebwaegita, taudi wete mwalohene ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ta wasaina geya ꞌilemedi, weyahina sihesagoheya ta geya sihemise.
Ma tauda ꞌana tohemisao talobeya, ma hesi taudi mwalohene geya sida lobeya, weyahina geya sihemise, ta Yehoba ꞌadi gwae ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Yagamwasowalediya ꞌoinega yagwae paꞌalediya ta sahena ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasi ꞌoiguwega silobaloba.”

content: Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasiina ꞌimiyamiya, weyahina tutaina baleꞌu mabwaiyana ꞌihemasalehediya ta ꞌigumwala, ta ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌaiyawasiya.
Ta sabweloina ꞌiꞌaiyawasiya, weyahina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌihepwaila pwaiya, ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Yehoba sabwelo hesebenina ꞌoina ꞌina paihowa mabwaiyana ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌaiyawasiya.”

content: Moisa, ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasiina ꞌimiyamiya, ta tupwadimo ꞌabehega siloba, ma hesi taudi wasa sihesagohe nugeteya, ta loina sisinaliya, ꞌoinega sahena silobaloba.
Eeta Yehoba tuta hauhauna ꞌilaguya ma ꞌoina tomota ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasi siloba, ta ꞌoinega sanapu ꞌiꞌebwaeya Debida ꞌoina ta Debidaina ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Nata hesi ꞌeguma Yehoba ꞌenana wahesagohe, sahena wadebadeba paꞌala.”

content: Ta ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasiina Yehoba ꞌigwaeneya geya Yosuwa ma ꞌana bodao ꞌidi ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasi, ta hesi hali ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasi, beno tuta ꞌaigeda hauhauna ꞌilaguya ma ꞌabehega tomota ꞌidi ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasiina siloba.
Coinega Yehoba ꞌina tomota tauda ꞌida ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasi ꞌimiyamiya, ta ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasiina Sabati ꞌana ꞌaiyawasi gide.
Eeta ꞌeguma taloba, tauda ꞌida paihowega taꞌaiyawasi, gide Yehoba mwalo ꞌina paihowega ꞌiꞌaiyawasi ꞌesa.
Ma ꞌilobwainegita ma tatoho waiwai ꞌabehega ꞌebe ꞌaiyawasiina taloba, ma sahena ꞌaigeda taiya ꞌilologwahata, ꞌamuge ta ꞌibeꞌu, taudi gide mwalo sibeꞌu ꞌesa.
Moisa, Yehoba ꞌina gwae mayawasina ta waiwaina gide ꞌelepa ꞌaleha ꞌina matamatagi matupwa luwaluwana, ta sawasawahina ꞌibadigita ꞌaloda moisa, beno nuwatuhu ta mumuga dahwanedi simiyamiya.
Weyahina Yehoba matana geya ꞌeta wete toꞌaha ꞌimiya dahwana, mabwaiyana siloꞌatamanediya, ta tauna ꞌoina ꞌabwa ꞌida paihowa mabwaiyana tahepwailedi.
Cida Topwaoli Madouna ma ꞌausalana ꞌimiyamiya, tauna Yesu, Yehoba Natuna, weyahida ꞌihane pwaiya galewa, ꞌoinega ꞌida hemisa ꞌoina taꞌabiyahi momosi.

Tupwadi topwaoliyao geya sida ꞌatemuyamuyaegita ꞌida weꞌa weyahidi, ta hesi Yesu ꞌida miyamwau ꞌinuwa sabwalenidiya ta ꞌiꞌatemuyemuyegita, weyahina mwalo baleꞌuwa Tomudulele ꞌina ꞌebetoho mabwaiyana ꞌilobediya gide tauda talobaloba ꞌesedi, ta Yesu geya ꞌeta wete ꞌina pui.
Coinega maꞌida ꞌatepatu tanao ma taꞌahwanoi ꞌada toloinaina ꞌoina, ta ꞌoinega ꞌida miyamwau ꞌoidiya ꞌiꞌatemuyemuyegita, ta wete ꞌiꞌabihetegita.
